method: Captured BEFORE any PF-3D change, from the PF-3C evaluation (qa/post_freeze_pf3c/results.json: the DIRECT pass with the D-111 guide path record) read against the guide page rows (cache pages). Each of the 27 core guide questions Plan F did not serve in PF-3C gets ONE primary reason and a class: LEGITIMATE (the fallback is the correct behaviour: policy or authority, conflict, unsupported specialist, ambiguous ownership, no procedure printed, order not provable), STRUCTURAL (a false fallback caused by how the PDF structure was read: unmarked or glyph-bulleted steps, mixed list shapes, headings not detected or split across rows, sections continued across pages), NON_STRUCTURAL (a false fallback whose cause is not structure: an asked word the guide does not print, the reranker gate, a sub-task inside a larger procedure, a cross-document clause). Only STRUCTURAL cases are in scope for PF-3D.

G02.note: identity verification is one bulleted step inside 'How to access Blackboard'; the heading names another action. A sub-task rule, not structure, would be needed.

G04.note: the Details & Actions options are glyph-separated 'Label: description' items (also unmarked), but the asked word 'panel' is not printed; structure alone cannot serve it.

G06.note: the answer is the 'o Private' option ('Make a course private while you add ...'); the asked words 'keep', 'hidden', 'build' are not printed.

G07.note: the Upload item lists the file types but does not print 'course'; the list also opens page 7 under no heading.

G08.note: the keyboard steps 1-4 under the lead-in sentence 'With your keyboard, you can move an item ...' are complete; the PF-2 reading took the next section label 'D. Edit and delete content:' for a fifth (lettered) step and carried an earlier heading.

G09.note: section 'Add a Learning Module or Folder:' (page 8) with glyph-bulleted action lines, bounded by the next heading 'Add a Document or martials:'; the glyph bullets are not read as list markers.

G10.note: section 'Send an Announcement:' (page 9): eight glyph-bulleted action lines in order; page 10 opens with its own heading.

G11.note: section 'Create an Assignment:' (page 10) continued on page 11, which opens under no heading; unmarked instructions mixed with assignment settings.

G13.primary: relevant evidence but no procedure structure
G13.note: the guide states that student preview lets you review the course (callout E) but prints no steps; a procedure ask is never answered by one statement.

G14.note: routed to Institutional Navigation, which D-110 does not approve for the gradebook guide.

G15.note: the list 1. List View / a) / b) / 2. Student grid View is introduced by the sentence 'You can grade coursework, manage items, and post grades from two views:', split across two rows; the PF-2 reading kept only the fragment 'items, and post grades from two views' as a heading (a fragment, so refused), and read '1. Global Grades Page' and '2. Course gradebook' (sub-section titles) as steps.

G16.note: the Post action is item 4 of the numbered student-grid list of independent actions; nothing proves the list is unordered, so one item cannot answer a procedure ask (the selection question P11 is served).

G17.note: section 'Assign automatic zeros:' (page 8) is narrative with three instructions (select Settings, select the check box, Next select Assign Zeros); its end, the short heading 'Filter by child courses', is not detected.

G18.note: '1. Download Worflow' and '2. Upload a file to the gradebook' are numbered sub-section titles, not steps; the download sub-section holds one instruction and the bulleted selections under 'Make your selections:'.

G19.note: section 'Add accommodations from the Student list view:' (page 5): 'You can set accommodations for individual students ... Select the three-dot options menu ... Select the Accommodations option ...'; unmarked steps and a heading verb ('Add') that differs from the asked one ('set') while the section's own first sentence states it.

G20.note: '6. Add a row: Select the plus sign ...:' with the alternatives a) Add Item, b) Add Calculation, c) Add Attendance, inside the capability list 'In the gradable items list, you can:'.

G21.note: the 255-character limit (pages 3 and 9) is below the production reranker gate for this question.

G22.note: section 'Filter by child courses' (page 8): a short heading without a colon, a lead-in ending with ':' and glyph-bulleted lines (select Filter ...); page 9 opens with its own heading.

G26.note: an approval-authority ask: never inferred from a guide's screens.

G27.note: routing: the clause is claimed by Teaching and Institutional Navigation.

G32.note: 'Files must be less than 100MB.' does not print 'upload'.

G33.note: routed to Institutional Navigation, which D-110 does not approve for iThenticate.

G34.note: the revision bullet does not print 'version', 'counting' or 'document' as asked; the File Requirements list carries the quota conflict.

G35.note: routed to Institutional Navigation, which D-110 does not approve for iThenticate.

G36.note: cross-document: the guide clause 'how do I transfer them to Banner' names no object ('them'), and the handbook deadline clause is not supported.

G37.note: cross-document: 'check a paper' is not printed by the similarity-report item, and the handbook clause is not supported.
